answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in reef and lotus lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the canyon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 789 impostors cost 677 times the honest price and take 24 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
